paragraphs.text: Quota windows — subscription and balance status for added providers in DeepSeek Harness
# Quota windows

A Harness plugin that puts one **额度窗口 / Quota windows** entry in the left
sidebar and one page behin

d it, showing the subscription and balance status of
every **added** provider whose usage or balance
API this plugin supports.
## Install

Clone this repository, then add it to your DSH profile as a linked dependency and
select the `quota-

The bundle name is `@local/quota-windows`; after the next load the sidebar entry

## Which providers appear

Discovery is dynamic. The Host reads the live LLM routes
(`llm.listProviders()`) and matches them ag

ainst an adapter registry; a provider
added in Settings whose family has an adapter appears automati

cally, with no
plugin change. Providers without a public usage or balance API are not matched
and st

in change. Providers without a public usage or balance API are not matched
and stay out of the page.
| Family | Route ids | Data |

| OpenCode Go | `opencode-go`, `opencode-go*` | 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月 usage windows |
| Claude | `anthropic

` (or the Claude Code credential on its own) | 5 小时 / 本周, Opus/Sonnet weekly, extra usage |
| DeepSe
ek | `deepseek`, `deepseek-official`, `deepseek-account` (or the signed-in account on its own) | rec

harge + bonus wallets |
| OpenRouter | `openrouter` | credit balance (total minus usage) |
| Moonsho

t / Kimi | `moonshotai`, `moonshotai-cn` | available + voucher balance |
| Z.ai / GLM | `zai`, `zai-

coding-cn` | Coding Plan quota windows (5h / weekly / other durations) |
| MiniMax | `minimax`, `min
imax-cn` | Token Plan session usage |

Each subscription card lists one row per window with its used percentage, a
severity-colored bar, an

d its reset time. Each balance card shows the available
amount and its wallets.
The overview's tight

est-window and next-reset tiles are buttons: clicking one
scrolls to the matching source card and br
iefly highlights it.

Credentials are resolved per provider from the settings profile's `apiKeyEnv`
(falling back to the c

onventional `<ROUTE>_API_KEY` reference) through
`ctx.credentials`; Claude reads the Claude CLI toke

n and DeepSeek uses the
account service, so neither needs a DSH route to be live.
## How it works

- `index.js` is the Host half: it matches live routes against `ADAPTERS`, reads
each match, caches s

uccesses for 60 seconds (errors for 15), and serves
`GET /quota-windows/api/snapshot` (add `?refresh

=1` to bypass the cache).
- `client.js` is the Web half: it registers the `sidebar.panellist` entry

and
the `main` panel, re-reads the snapshot whenever the page is entered, polls
every minute afterwa

rds, and renders one grid of equally sized cards
(three columns when the card count is a multiple of

three, two otherwise). A page-level error boundary keeps a render crash from
blanking the panel and
reports it to `GET /quota-windows/api/client-error`.
## Brand colors

Each source card uses its brand accent. The provider directory exposes ids,
names, and base URLs onl

y — no colors — so accents are a hand-maintained table
(`BRAND_ACCENTS` in `client.js`); ids outside

the table fall back to a stable
hash color, so a newly supported provider still gets a distinct acc

ent without a
code change.
## Configuration

Optional row config, validated by the Loader schema (`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`;
runtime coercion ap
plies if it is unavailable), for example in the profile patch:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Notes

- The Claude token is read, never refreshed; when it expires the card asks you
to sign in to Claude

Code again.
- OpenCode Zen credit balance is not exposed by the API-key API, so only the Go
subscrip

tion windows are shown.
- A provider family with no public usage/balance endpoint (for example OpenA

I,
Google, or a local model server) is intentionally not shown. Adding its
adapter is the only step

needed if such an endpoint appears later.
- All lookups are read-only.
- Provider failures are local

ized for HTTP status, timeout, and empty responses;
provider-specific text remains as the detail aft

er the localized prefix.
- `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` covers the pure parsers and the OpenRouter

,
Moonshot, Z.ai, and MiniMax adapters against stubbed HTTP responses.
